Header: Cnaphalocrocis medinalis Local name: Ilai madakkum puzhu

Prevention: Summer ploughing, trimming of bunds and destruction of crop residues.
Avoid excessive use of nitrogenous fertilizers, Avoid close planting; leave 30 cm space at every 2.5 m.
Monitoring: Use light traps at 12 places in paddy field in between 6 to 9 pm to monitor pest incidence.
Direct Control (Non-chemical): Trichogramma chilonis thrice at 3 cc per acre.
Spread neem leaves randomly in the field to deter the adults from egg laying.
Spray of neem oil 300 ml + kerosene 250 ml + 50 g khadi soap will be very effective.
Spray of 300 ml neem oil + 300 ml pongamia oil + 50 grams khadi soap will afford protection.
Place bamboo tops or twigs for perching of predatory birds soon after planting.
However, these are to be removed at flowering stage of the crop.
Direct Control (Chemical): Broad spectrum contact and stomach poison
Broad spectrum insecticide with contact and stomach action
